actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modal identity evidence (strong inflammatory/immune RNA activation, BAP1 enrichment, 9p/CDKN2A loss), molecular-modality membership support with moderate-to-good internal resampling stability (ARI 0.77), no plausible technical confounder (no CT field association; site association does not align with defining molecular modalities), and low stage/grade echo. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.

C0002 shows a coherent CNV-driven identity (coordinated 3p/14q loss at VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1 loci) with reduced inflammatory/proliferation RNA programs, broad cross-modal membership support with no low-support patients, no detected technical or site confounder, and low stage/grade echo. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.

C0003 has a coherent, highly significant defining signal (PBRM1-wildtype depletion, OR 0.017, q=5.8e-06) with consistent low VHL/BAP1 mutation, WXS-driven cross-modal membership support, no detected technical or site confounder, and low stage/grade echo. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.
